design.readSide: PRODUCTION_NEONDB_URL / neondb: landing_parcel_jurisdiction (which in-city parcels belong to which city), txgio_parcel (parcel ring geometry), tx_zoning_district_staging (zone polygons, filtered per city + layer_role='base').
design.writeSide: FACTORY_DATABASE_URL: parcel_record_cell, rails zoningDistrict / zoningJurisdictionKey / zoningProvenance. These rows already exist (every parcel starts with its full shape) as 'unaccounted' on every in-city landing-matched parcel; this job is a targeted UPDATE gated on cell_state->>'kind'='unaccounted', never an INSERT, and never touches a cell that is already 'value' or the frozen 'not-applicable' (unincorporated parcels, set at instantiate time, untouched here).
design.crossStoreShape: Not a single SQL join -- two separate databases. Per city: (1) materialize that city's base zoning polygons into a session TEMP table on the cortex-prod connection, GIST-indexed, mirroring p2-juris-store.mjs's HOIST_CITIES_SQL zone-major pattern exactly (detoast once, batch parcels through it) rather than a point-major LATERAL; (2) page that city's in-city landing parcels (per home county chunk, prop_id-ordered, mirroring CHUNK_GEOMETRY_SQL's decode/parcels_six/ranked structure) and spatially test each against the materialized polygons: ST_Covers fast path, ST_Intersects + ST_Area(ST_Intersection) with the same 1e-8 ring floor on a miss, bbox-centre fallback for a parcel lacking usable ring geometry, best match by row_number() PARTITION BY (county_fips, prop_id) ORDER BY overlap_deg2 DESC, district_code (tie-break, replacing p2-juris's place_fips tie-break since city is already fixed here); (3) batch the (place_key, rail_key, cell_state) results in application code and UPDATE Factory's parcel_record_cell gated on current kind, RETURNING to get an exact moved-count distinguishing genuinely-new stamps from cells another run already touched.
design.cellShape: value only: zoningDistrict.value = district_code (e.g. 'PDD', 'RR'); zoningJurisdictionKey.value = city_key (e.g. 'bastrop-tx'); zoningProvenance.value = source_url (the ArcGIS FeatureServer citation, not source_citation which is actually a prose district description despite its column name). source=tx_zoning_district_staging on all three, vintage=this job's own pinned nowIso.
design.cityScopeDerivedLive: The in-scope city list is computed at run time from tx_zoning_district_staging joined against landing_parcel_jurisdiction, not hardcoded to today's 18 -- with the five named stamp-gap city_keys (smithville-tx, luling-tx, martindale-tx, woodcreek-tx, lakeway-tx) excluded by an explicit hardcoded exclusion list per this card's dispatch scope. If a 19th city's layer appears later, this job would pick it up automatically; the exclusion of the five is a deliberate scope boundary, not an oversight, and is enforced in code, not merely in a report.
design.geometryGrainNote: 6 of 18 cities (austin-tx, bastrop-tx, leander-tx, robinson-tx, taylor-tx, waco-tx) have geometry_grain='parcel-joined' staging rows (each row's polygon is itself close to one specific parcel's shape, joined at the ArcGIS source); 12 have geometry_grain='district-polygon' (a true zoning-boundary polygon). The spatial-join mechanism (ST_Covers/ST_Intersects + area floor) is grain-agnostic and needs no special-casing -- a parcel-joined row's near-congruent shape simply produces a very high overlap ratio against its own parcel, which the existing ranking already favors correctly.
